responsibility: Defines the main token-buffer interface for the gm2 scanner `m2.lex`/`m2flex`. It exposes buffered token replay across passes, source open/close and reset operations, current token/string/integer state, token insertion and synthetic range-token creation, token-number to line/column/file/location queries, include-file stack updates, and lexer callback entry points used by the scanner to deposit tokens with full source provenance.
same_name_distinction: Definition module for the M2LexBuf pair: it specifies the replayable token-buffer API, exported current-token state, token/location query routines, insertion controls, and scanner callback entry points, while `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2LexBuf.mod` implements the buffered storage and source-stack bookkeeping behind them.
